answered.sql: SELECT T2.address, T3.city_name FROM Internship AS T1 JOIN Office_Address AS T2 ON T1.office_address_id = T2.id JOIN City AS T3 ON T2.city_id = T3.id JOIN Employee AS T4 ON T1.employee_id = T4.id WHERE T4.first_name = 'Alice' AND T4.last_name = 'Brown'

candidates.sql: SELECT Department.department_name, Office_Address.address, Office_Address.postal_code FROM Employee JOIN Department ON Employee.department_id = Department.id JOIN Office_Address ON Department.company_id = Office_Address.company_id WHERE Employee.first_name = 'Alice' AND Employee.last_name = 'Brown'

candidates.meaning: Find the office location where Alice Brown is associated with, either as an intern or an employee.
candidates.sql: SELECT Office_Address.address, Office_Address.postal_code FROM (Internship UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS internship_id, Employee.id AS employee_id, Employee.first_name, Employee.last_name FROM Employee WHERE Employee.first_name = 'Alice' AND Employee.last_name = 'Brown') AS EmployeeOrIntern JOIN Office_Address ON (Internship.office_address_id = Office_Address.id OR EmployeeOrIntern.employee_id IN (SELECT Employee.id FROM Employee WHERE Employee.first_name = 'Alice' AND Employee.last_name = 'Brown'))
